reasons: Claimed status is compliant with no redline and no comment, which is the expected output shape; the rendered redline is identical to the original paragraphs, so no unwanted edit was introduced.

The cited text supports the rationale: p0014 imposes invoice substantiation duties on the Contractor (not audit rights over Customer records), and p0007's only system-access language obliges Contractor personnel to follow Company security policies — it binds the counterparty, not us.

Absence of any audit/inspection/verification right against the Customer is more protective than the AUDIT preferred parameters (frequency, notice, cost, no system access), so there is nothing to limit; proposing an audit right would introduce a counterparty benefit and is correctly avoided.
The failed 'audit frequency limited' deterministic check is a false signal here — it can only match where an audit clause exists, and none does in this agreement.
